commands.name: add-entity
commands.description: Spawn a new entity from an archetype or bundle.

parameters.name: archetypeOrDef
parameters.description: Archetype name string or inline entity definition.

anyOf.description: Archetype name registered in the engine.

definition.description: Entity definition bundle keyed by component name.

parameters.name: overrides
parameters.description: Component overrides to apply after spawning.

commands.name: delete-entity
commands.description: Delete an entity by its stable ID.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to delete.

commands.name: duplicate-entity
commands.description: Duplicate an entity with an optional offset.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to duplicate.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional offset { x, y, z } applied to the duplicate.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to transform.

parameters.name: transform
parameters.description: Transform values to apply (supports partials).

commands.name: add-component
commands.description: Add a component to an entity.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: componentName
parameters.description: Component name to add.

parameters.name: componentData
parameters.description: Component payload to attach.

commands.name: remove-component
commands.description: Remove a component from an entity.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: componentName
parameters.description: Component name to remove.

commands.name: modify-component
commands.description: Modify an existing component on an entity.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: componentName
parameters.description: Component name to update.

parameters.name: componentData
parameters.description: New component payload.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Body definition overrides.

commands.name: insert-body-part
commands.description: Insert a new body part into a composite body.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: parentPath
parameters.description: Path to the parent body part (array of node ids).

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: Body part definition to insert.

commands.name: add-body-part
commands.description: Append a new body part to a composite body.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: archetype
parameters.description: Body part archetype to add.

parameters.name: localPosition
parameters.description: Local position { x, y, z } for the new body part.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to modify.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the body part (array of node ids).

parameters.name: transform
parameters.description: Transform values to apply (position/rotation/scale).

parameters.name: definition
parameters.description: Full world definition to load.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: World settings to update.

commands.name: upsert-module-type
commands.description: Register or replace a persisted runtime module type backed by factory source.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Target module name (for example "field" or "material").

parameters.name: typeName
parameters.description: Registered type name within the target module.

parameters.name: factorySource
parameters.description: JavaScript source that evaluates to a factory function `(params, helpers) => resolvedValue`.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional human-readable description of the custom type.

parameters.name: parameterSchema
parameters.description: Optional JSON-schema-like description of the expected params payload.

commands.name: remove-module-type
commands.description: Remove a persisted runtime module type.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Target module name.

parameters.name: typeName
parameters.description: Registered type name to remove.

commands.name: upsert-module-instance
commands.description: Register or replace a named module instance.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Target module name.

parameters.name: instanceName
parameters.description: Instance name within the module.

parameters.name: definition
parameters.description: Module definition `{ type, params }` to register.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Target module name.

parameters.name: instanceName
parameters.description: Instance name to remove.

commands.name: set-viewport-camera
commands.description: Set the current viewport camera pose.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Optional camera position { x, y, z }.

parameters.name: lookAt
parameters.description: Optional look-at target { x, y, z }.

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Optional camera rotation as quaternion { x, y, z, w } or Euler angles { x, y, z }.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: Optional perspective FOV in degrees.

commands.name: frame-viewport-entity
commands.description: Move the viewport camera to frame one entity by stable ID.

parameters.name: stableId
parameters.description: Stable ID of the entity to frame.

parameters.name: padding
parameters.description: Optional framing padding multiplier.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: Optional perspective FOV in degrees.
